source.notes: ICSE Grade VIII school assessment paper. Header prints 'Grade - VIII', 'SCHOOL' (no school name), 'Assessment - I', 'Computer', 'Time- 2 hours', 'M.M: 50'. No year is printed on the paper; examYear 2023 is taken from the file name (...-150323-2023) and the icseboard.org folder. The PDF has no text layer (watermark only); text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against the page images. Marks are printed only per group, so each group is one entry with its printed total. 'VIII. Practical [20]' is printed with no question text, so it is not included; the listed questions total 30 of 50. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.

questions.text:
Choose the correct answer:-
1. With GUI the users have to (a) Type commands (b) Select Icons (c) Speak out commands (d) Choose commands on screen
2. Choose the odd one (a) MS Dos (b) MS Windows (c) Linux (d) MS office
3. A formula in MS Excel begins with (a) _ (b) ( (c) number (d) None of these
4. ____is the symbol for decision making (a) Oval (b) Rectangle (c) diamond (d) Arrow
5. What is the output of the function =Count(50,30,20) (a) 100 (b) 3 (c) 50 (d) 0.3
6. Linux is an (a) Application Software (b)Operating System for networked environment (c) Open Source Operating System (d) Software owned by a company

5. Utilities are programs used to carry out routine tasks that are often needed by a user.
